editor.title: Document designer
editor.readOnly: You can view this. Designing is an org admin's act.
editor.mobileNotice: On a small screen this is preview and approval only. The layer editor needs a wider window; a cramped one is a bad tool pretending to be a feature.
editor.realDataNote: The preview uses real data, never lorem ipsum: Arabic runs longer than Latin and carries marks above the line, so a layout that fits fake text overflows with real text.
editor.phoneNotice: On a phone you review rather than edit: the preview, every size and the checks, then «Request export». Editing needs a screen wider than <bdi>{width}</bdi> points.

scheme.hint: A template carries no colour scheme: a certificate is issued light or dark by what is chosen for its session.

liveGate.title: This poster is linked to its template
liveGate.body: It is generated from the template and the session's data and rebuilt on every change, so it cannot be edited here while it stays linked. Detach it first to edit it; detaching is one way.

save.error: The save failed. Your edits are still here; try again.
save.conflict: Another admin saved a newer version of this document. Reload before you continue, so neither of you loses work.
save.lockedRegion: This region is locked in the template: <bdi>{layer}</bdi>
save.invalid: Something in the document prevents saving: <bdi>{issue}</bdi>
save.forbidden: Designing is an org admin's act.

layers.heading: Layers
layers.count: {count, plural, =0 {No layers} one {One layer} other {{value} layers}}
layers.empty: This document has no layers yet.
layers.orderHint: Reorder with the buttons: higher in the list is nearer the viewer.

properties.heading: Properties
properties.none: Select a layer to see its properties.
properties.lockedNotice: This region is locked in the template: it cannot be moved, resized, hidden or deleted. Unlocking happens in the platform template, not here.
properties.alignNote: Alignment is logical — start and end, never left and right — so it mirrors with the text direction instead of being redrawn.
properties.letterSpacingNote: Letter-spacing is always zero in Arabic: spacing it breaks the cursive join, which makes a broken word rather than a loose one.

bindings.heading: Dynamic fields
bindings.unboundHint: An unbound field draws a marked box on the canvas, never a blank — a blank exports as white space nobody notices until it is printed.
bindings.empty: This document carries no dynamic fields.

presets.heading: Sizes
presets.intro: Every size derives from the master with no manual step. Text re-fits per size, so the link card's title is genuinely smaller rather than a downscaled image.
presets.bleedHint: Print sizes carry a bleed that is trimmed after printing, and a safe area whose contents survive however the blade lands.

checks.heading: Before export
checks.clean: Nothing crosses the safe area on any size.
checks.intro: Anything crossing the safe area appears here before export, not after: after printing there is no fix.
checks.safeArea: The layer <bdi>{layer}</bdi> crosses the safe area on <bdi>{preset}</bdi> by <bdi>{px}</bdi> px.
checks.minSize: The layer <bdi>{layer}</bdi> reached the smallest size the template allows on <bdi>{preset}</bdi> and is still taller than its frame. The template will not shrink it further.
checks.maxLines: The layer <bdi>{layer}</bdi> wrapped past the line limit on <bdi>{preset}</bdi>.
checks.ppiWarn: The image on layer <bdi>{layer}</bdi> resolves to <bdi>{ppi}</bdi> PPI on <bdi>{preset}</bdi>, below what print wants. It will look soft.
checks.ppiBlock: The image on layer <bdi>{layer}</bdi> resolves to <bdi>{ppi}</bdi> PPI on <bdi>{preset}</bdi>, below the print minimum. Export for that size is blocked until a higher-resolution image is uploaded.
checks.ppiHint: Logos are raster, not vector — we do not accept SVG, because an XML file opened inside a privileged browser is a risk that buys nothing. Supply a high-resolution logo, or the guard blocks the large print sizes.
checks.badge: {count, plural, zero {No open checks} one {One check} two {Two checks} few {{value} checks} many {{value} checks} other {{value} checks}}

exports.heading: Export queue
exports.intro: Each size exports as its own job and its status appears here. The preview you approve is the file that goes to print, not a picture of it.
exports.none: No export has been requested for this version yet.
exports.rgbCaveat: Print files are RGB, not CMYK. The print shop will convert them and the navy may shift slightly in the conversion — tell them before the run. Saying it costs one line; discovering it costs two hundred posters.
exports.cacheNote: Nothing re-renders while the source is unchanged: the same key means the same file. Any edit to the design, to the session's data, or to the template version produces a new key, and only that is rendered again.
exports.queuedNotice: The sizes were added to the export queue.
exports.notAuthorized: Exporting is an org admin's act.
exports.emptyDescription: The preview you approve is the very file that goes to print. Request the export to see it.

reasons.textDidNotFit: The text did not fit at the size designed for it in this format, so the export stopped rather than print something different from what you approved.
reasons.fontNeverLoaded: The font did not load while rendering, so the export stopped rather than print in a fallback font.
reasons.layoutMismatch: What was drawn in this format does not match what was measured for it, so the export stopped.
reasons.blank: The file came out blank, so the export stopped.
reasons.fonts: The approved fonts were not available for this render.
reasons.invalidDocument: The saved document is not valid. Open the designer and save it again.
reasons.documentChanged: The design changed after the export was requested. Request the export again.
reasons.jpegDisabled: JPEG export is not enabled for your organisation.
reasons.unknown: This format could not be rendered.

poster.none: This session has no poster yet.
poster.stale: The session's details changed — review the poster.
poster.staleWhy: This poster is customised, so it is not regenerated automatically: an edit that erases someone's work is worse than a prompt asking them to look.

picker.heading: Poster
picker.intro: Every published session has a poster, three ways. The automatic one produces every size with no design work at all.
picker.autoHint: Built from the template and the session's data, and rebuilt whenever the title, time, venue or presenters change.
picker.customiseHint: Opens the designer once the poster is detached from its template, one way: it is never regenerated automatically again, only flagged when details change.
picker.uploadHint: At least <bdi>{minimum}</bdi> px on the short side, checked on content rather than extension. An uploaded poster is detached from the start, and every size is cropped from it.
picker.readOnly: Choosing how the poster is made is an admin's.
picker.autoDetached: There is no way back to automatic after detaching: a detached poster is never replaced from the template.

detach.title: Customise the poster for «<bdi>{title}</bdi>»?
detach.body: The poster is detached from its template before the designer opens, one way: it is never regenerated automatically, and if the title, time, venue or presenters change you are told to review it yourself.
detach.brand: Your organisation's brand colours still apply to it, so a change to them shows at its next export.
detach.failed: The poster could not be detached. Try again.

replace.title: Replace the poster for «<bdi>{title}</bdi>»?
replace.auto: The uploaded poster replaces the automatic one, one way: it is never regenerated from the template afterwards.
replace.customised: The uploaded poster replaces the customised one, and its edits are not kept.
replace.uploaded: The new poster replaces the one uploaded before.

picker.uploaded: Poster uploaded; its sizes are being prepared.

uploadErrors.file_too_large: The file is larger than the limit (<bdi>{limit}</bdi> MB).
uploadErrors.rejected_content: The file's content is not a <bdi>PNG</bdi>, <bdi>JPEG</bdi> or <bdi>WebP</bdi> image, whatever its extension.
uploadErrors.too_small: The image's short side is <bdi>{shortSide}</bdi> px; the minimum is <bdi>{minimum}</bdi>.
uploadErrors.unreadable: The image could not be read. Try another file.
uploadErrors.not_authorized: Uploading a poster is an admin's.
uploadErrors.unknown: The poster could not be uploaded. Try again.

inspector.documentHint: Select a layer to see its properties. With nothing selected, the document's own properties show.
inspector.positionNote: Collapsed by default and never removed: the numbers are the path that needs no dragging, and the most exact one.

align.note: Alignment follows the document's own axis: «start» on an Arabic poster is its right edge, whatever the interface language.

background.angleHint: The angle is the Arabic source's; the English variant mirrors by itself.
background.tokenNote: Brand colours only — no colour typed by hand, so a brand change reaches every template.
